rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of IP addresses in req.subdomains getter
rawFindings.explanation: The change removes special handling for IP addresses in the req.subdomains getter. Previously, if the host was detected as an IP address (IPv4 or IPv6), the subdomains array would contain the whole IP address as a single item. After the change, the code always splits the host on dots and reverses it, which will incorrectly split IP addresses like '127.0.0.1' into ['1','0','0','127'] becoming subdomains. This breaks expected behavior that programs relying on req.subdomains to handle IP addresses
rawFindings.suggestion: Reinstate the check for IP addresses using isIP(host) and return [host] if it is an IP address, otherwise split on '.' and reverse as before.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of IP addresses in req.subdomains getter
rawFindings.explanation: The change removes the check for IP address using isIP() and treats the host string as a domain by splitting on '.' and reversing, even if the host is an IP address. Previously, IP addresses were returned as a single element array of the whole host, which is correct since IP addresses do not have subdomains. The new code will split IP addresses by dots resulting in array parts that are IP address octets instead of the entire IP string as one entry, which breaks the expected behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the isIP check and return the host as a single-element array if it is an IP address, otherwise split by '.' and reverse.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of IP addresses in req.subdomains getter
rawFindings.explanation: The change removes the conditional check that returned the host as a single element array if it was an IP address. Now, the host string (which can be an IP address) is blindly split on '.', leading to incorrect subdomains arrays for IP addresses (e.g., '127.0.0.1' becomes ['1','0','0','127']). This breaks expected behavior where IP addresses should be returned as a single-element array containing the whole IP string.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the conditional check using isIP(host) to return [host] for IP addresses instead of splitting the IP string on dots.
